command.tacz_pubg.help.config: Configuration: /pubgdebug config opens the full GUI for loot probabilities, gun settings, maps/regions/display, match rules, teams and lobbies. Requires a player.
command.tacz_pubg.help.create: Create: /pubgdebug create map <x1 z1> <x2 z2>; safezone|bombingzone|staging <x z> <radius> [mapId]; flightpath <x1 z1> <x2 z2> [mapId]; loot saves the loot tool selection. Coordinates support ~; zones must fit their map.
command.tacz_pubg.help.destroy: Delete: /pubgdebug destroy map <mapId> confirm force-deletes the map, stops its match and abandons pending capture/restoration, removes its match template and lobby, and preserves current terrain. Without confirm it only explains the operation. safezone|flightpath|staging [mapId]; bombingzone <zoneId> [mapId]; loot removes floors inside the loot tool selection. Omitted map IDs use your current map.
command.tacz_pubg.help.loot: Loot: /pubgdebug loot area add|remove|clearSelection; area info [regionId]; area list [page]; area clear confirm clears confirmed floors in the current dimension (hold the tool); show <true|false> toggles your overlay; respawn refreshes loot across maps; respawn status shows progress. Edit probabilities and colors in config.
command.tacz_pubg.help.map: Maps: /pubgdebug map list | info [mapId] | select <mapId> | create <x1 z1> <x2 z2> | destroy <mapId> confirm | unfreeze [mapId] | freeze [mapId]. destroy force-deletes without waiting for capture or restoration; without confirm it only explains the operation. journal status|retry [mapId] shows status or retries; journal list shows every map. Omitted IDs use your current map, newest on overlap; console requires IDs. select only sets editor selection. Use unfreeze to edit, then freeze and wait for the baseline before starting.
command.tacz_pubg.help.map_recovery: Recovery: /pubgdebug map skipEntities [mapId] confirm skips entity capture or restoration; skipTerrain [mapId] confirm skips terrain restoration; skipRestore [mapId] confirm skips all remaining restoration. Large-map entity choice: recordEntities [mapId] confirm records entities; ignoreEntities [mapId] confirm excludes entities. Without the final confirm these commands only explain the operation. Omit mapId to use the map at your feet. Skipping does not undo completed restoration.
command.tacz_pubg.help.match: Matches: /pubgdebug match start|end|pause|resume|info [mapId]. Omit the ID to use your current map, newest on overlap; console requires IDs. pause pauses match timing and rules. Use map unfreeze for terrain editing.
command.tacz_pubg.help.player: /pubgplayer list lists managed bots; /pubgplayer <name> status; behavior auto|seek|loot|attack|evade|patrol|guard|hold; movement move <x y z>|follow <teammate>|stop|enter-circle; combat fire hold|free or combat reload; manage despawn. Bots are created through the match lobby.
command.tacz_pubg.help.root: PUBG administration: config (GUI), map (maps and protection), match (matches), create, destroy, loot, and /pubgplayer (bots). Use /pubgdebug help <group> or /pubgdebug <group> help for syntax. Requires OP 2.
